name: semantic-site
displayName: semantic-site — static semantic websites with WebMCP on every page
description: Generate static websites from data (CSV, JSON, JSON-LD, N-Triples) where every page is HTML content, JSON-LD, a static JSON API entry and WebMCP tools for in-browser agents. Plus a skill for adding WebMCP to any page and a checker. No framework, no build step, any static host.
